name: Father Of All Lies
overview: Scripture reveals that the devil is the originator and father of all lies, characterized by his rejection of truth and his role as a deceiver of the whole world. Jesus Christ stands in direct contrast as the embodiment of truth and the only way to the Father. Those who follow the devil live in falsehood and face eternal judgment, while believers are called to be trained in the truth from childhood to remain steadfast in righteousness.
